en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Ali bin Ibrahim, from Muhammed bin Isa, from Yunus ibn Abdil-Rahman, from Hisham bin Salem, that he said: I heard Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, say:
Allah has not been worshipped with anything more beloved to him than Al-Khaba'a. I said: And what is Al-Khaba'a? He said: Taqiya.
